s.zh: 盘旋的巨龙朝地面喷出了一道力场吐息！落点附近的建筑和物品被撕裂了
s.en: The circling dragon breathed a blast of force at the ground! Buildings and items near the impact were torn apart
, leaving a force crater on the ground.

s.zh:
一条巨龙在这片天空上盘旋，接下来一天里它的影子会不时掠过大地。龙影经过的地方，野兽会惊慌逃离。

殖民者看着头顶的巨龙心里发毛（心情-3）。

它偶尔可能朝地面喷一口力场吐息。
s.en:
A great dragon is circling this sky, and over the next day its shadow will sweep across the land now and then. Wherever the dragon's shadow passes, beasts flee in panic.

Colonists feel uneasy watching the dragon overhead (mood -3).

It may occasionally breathe a blast of force at the ground.
